items.headline: Z.ai releases GLM-5
items.summary: GLM-5 is an MIT-licensed mixture-of-experts model with 744B total and 40B active parameters, pretrained on 28.5T tokens and using DeepSeek Sparse Attention with a 200K context window. Z.ai reports 77.8 on SWE-bench Verified and best-in-class results among open models on reasoning, coding and agent tasks.
